binding_counterexamples.limit: Existing native admission should reject fallback; this demonstrates missing root plan pin, not bypass of science guards.

findings.body: The runner verifies plan/review hashes but reads release_barrier.json directly and checks only root_authorizer/active. A fake-root replacement with an empty waiter list passes these guards despite a different SHA from the reviewed barrier. It can skip the intended natural-release wait. The unchanged original launcher still enforces a free exclusive lease, so this is not a demonstrated bypass of device occupancy guards.
findings.fix: Resolve plan.release_barrier, require the exact expected path/ref and SHA, then validate/use that bound object before any wait receipt or stage start. Rebind a fresh current natural-release barrier for V2; root reported new live GPU2 workers after this V1 barrier was prepared.
findings.title: Release barrier is read without the plan-pinned hash

findings.body: admission() selects proposals by filename and checks only source/config digests. A changed proposal is activated despite a hash different from the12 plan refs. Likewise the activation-selected budget receipt is hash-checked against activation but never compared with plan.budget_receipt; a different receipt passes the prefix. Existing native admission should reject invalid scientific fields, as in the fallback fixture, but the root runner can activate unreviewed metadata.
findings.fix: Require activation.budget_receipt == plan.budget_receipt. Build a unique exact12 (parent,stage) map; resolve and hash each pinned proposal and registration before activation, require their mutual registration reference and parent/stage, and retain original science/runtime/storage/launcher gates.
findings.title: Stage proposals and activated budget receipt are not tied to the reviewed plan

notes.body: The delta artifact still advertises c97f1a388f75928e6a5e82b41445c5f9e75944298d2609c833cc1367c2e7a431 while reviewed runner is cc67a0a159dd25426d1825faa3033b52dba28d36bc95e597bff9b8b4fadbde99. Refresh it truthfully for the immutable V2 successor.

prior_related_work_disclosure: Reviewer authored native V7 scientific source earlier; this review is of the separately root-authored queue/plan metadata only. Existing native source independent PASS is unchanged and is not re-reviewed here.
